12 evenings of 2025, one a month: what the community promised, and what was delivered

Each evening ran on a local NANDA Town with eight homes, a small office and shops of ENGIE's community 19, their community agent and the aggregator's agent, on ENGIE's 2025 records with ENGIE's own weather. The community agent's record is carried from one evening to the next. Pick an evening to play it.

In short: 12 evenings, one in each month of 2025, on ENGIE's own weather. Averaged over them the community promised 91.1 kW and delivered 90.3 kW by the truth and 102.0 kW by the buyers' meter. The truth met the promise on 5 of 12 evenings. Delivery was short by the truth in 45 of 72 half hours, and by the buyers' meter in 18. As its own record grew, the community agent lowered the share of the offers it promises, to 70% at the lowest. NANDA Town carried 4,240 signed messages, and no signature failed.

Not real in these runs: devices and meters are simulated, the members' batteries are replayed from ENGIE's record as one total, and stand-ins take the place of the buyers and of the aggregator's own agent.

Written 2026-11-20 01:48. kW are averages over the evening, 18:00 to 21:00. The truth is what the simulated devices did; the buyers' meter is what the buyers measured and paid on. The figures are the runs' own, and nothing is typed in by hand.
